title.narrative: IMPROVING THE ENROLMENT OF FEMALE SAHO CHILDREN THROUGH MOBILIZING THE SAHO COMMUNITY.

description.narrative: Southern Region is one of the densely populated regions of the country (Eritrea). Currently, it has about 800,000 population. It is one of the regions which share common boundary with Ethiopia. Large portion of the population in the region is affected by the 1998-2000 war of aggression, which was waged by the Tigray regime that resulted in the displacement of about 38 Schools with 22,202 students and 372 teachers. The Tigray claimed some parts of these sub regions. School Facilities were pillaged by the Tigray military force. Although virtual demarcation had been given by the Hague, there had been skirmishes until 2022. As a result, there is feeling of trauma in the children. There is a need of helping the people in general and the children in particular. The economic activities of the region are predominantly agricultural with a very limited semi-pastoralism in the lowland areas.
